filename: SOMA_Infrastructure_<mode>_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>_<8hex>.xlsx; timestamp is America/Guayaquil presentation chronology and 8hex is first 8 chars of export_id without identity meaning
writer: openpyxl write-only; no formulas/macros/external links/hidden authoritative sheets
verifier: reopen generated file read-only; verify exact profile/version/sheet order/required headers/row counts, absence of active content and SHA-256 before publication evidence
publication: write unique temp file in chosen destination, fsync/close as supported, verify, then atomic same-filesystem replace into a filename that must not already exist; collision chooses a new suffix rather than overwriting operator file
failure: failed/unverified temp artifacts are deleted only when job proves ownership; existing operator files are never edited/deleted
source_round_trip: import reader uses the same profile and SourceInstallationScopeId=data_instance_id; exporter/importer versions must match exactly.
